info.title: linkedin_ads (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: LinkedIn Marketing API (REST/v2). Used for managing LinkedIn Ads audiences (Matched Audiences / DMP Segments), sending conversion events, and creating reports. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token} and LinkedIn-Version header. Audiences are called DMP Segments. Contacts are identified by hashed email.

Audience.description: A LinkedIn Matched Audience represented as a DMP Segment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audience or segment.

audience_type.description: Specifies whether the audience targets users or companies.

account_id.description: The associated LinkedIn Ads account ID.

member_count.description: Total number of members currently in the audience.

ConversionEvent.description: A tracked conversion event within LinkedIn Ads.

account_id.description: The associated LinkedIn Ads account ID.

conversion_name.description: Name of the conversion action being tracked.

value.description: Financial value attributed to the conversion.

currency_code.description: Currency expressed as an ISO 4217 code.

Report.description: A generated LinkedIn Ads analytics report.

report_type.description: Category or type of the report.
